Dreamy cinematic blue-hour garden illuminated by many warm golden hanging paper lanterns, soft amber bokeh, subtle festive atmosphere, elegant gold and midnight-blue palette. One continuous smooth slow camera push forward along the glowing lantern-lined garden path, lanterns gently swaying in the breeze, beautiful realistic lighting and stable composition. Show an elegant highly legible centered title 'LANTERN NIGHT', with smaller text below reading 'Light up the night with us'. Keep text steady and comfortably inside the central safe area. End on the glowing lantern scene and title. No dates, no location, no logos, no additional words.
